description: Phase 3 sweep S8 (E12b): the context-preserving order-1 circuit (E11, 3 context + 1 prediction qubit) trained with the QBGU superposed loss versus mini-batch per-sample SGD at equal shots (3000 SPSA iterations x 10,000 shots per loss evaluation): batch 1 (10,000 shots on one window), 100 (100 shots each), 10,000 (1 shot each). Raw and MA5 data; classical baselines rerun as reference. Evaluation matrix: no winner selected.

evaluation.split: test = chronological last 20 % of T+1 windows
evaluation.checkpoint: final iteration for quantum models; validation-selected refit for baselines
evaluation.aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation over seeds; paired-by-seed differences with a 95 % t interval
evaluation.tie_rule: a paired difference whose 95 % interval contains 0 is reported as not distinguishable
